{{short description|Cryptographic cipher}}
In [[cryptography]], '''Cobra''' is the general name of a family of data-dependent permutation based [[block cipher]]s: Cobra-S128, Cobra-F64a, Cobra-F64b, Cobra-H64, and Cobra-H128. In each of these names, the number indicates the cipher's [[block size (cryptography)|block size]], and the capital letter indicates whether it is optimized for implementation in software, firmware, or hardware.
